```lean
theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) : (n ^ 2 + n) % 2 = 0 := by
  have h : (n ^ 2 + n) % 2 = (n ^ 2 % 2 + n % 2) % 2 := by rw [mod_add_right]
  have h1 : n ^ 2 % 2 = n % 2 := by rw [Nat.pow_mod]
  rw [h1] at h
  have h2 : n % 2 + n % 2 = 0 % 2 ∨ n % 2 + n % 2 = 1 % 2 := by cases n % 2; rfl
  cases h2 with h3 h4
  · rw [h3] at h
    rw [add_zero] at h
    exact h
  · rw [h4] at h
    rw [add_one] at h
    exact h
```
